title: Keep the Girls Apart | AMC 8-Style Level 4
description:
Five boys and three girls line up at random. What is the chance that no two girls end up side by side? Vantee shows how to count just the girls' spots, gives a fast second way by placing the boys first and choosing gaps, explains why each wrong answer is tempting, and gives you a new line-up to try yourself.
